description.value: The EXchange Hotel Vancouver is a luxury boutique hotel occupying the former Vancouver Stock Exchange building, recognized as Vancouver's first LEED Platinum heritage conversion. The historic Art Deco structure has been transformed by an international architectural collaboration and is now listed in the Michelin Guide and featured by Condé Nast Traveler. Situated in the core of downtown Vancouver, it is less than 200 metres from Waterfront SkyTrain station and 350 metres from the cruise ship terminal.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel's address (475 Howe St, Vancouver, BC V6C 2B3) and phone (604.563.4693) matching OSM exactly. Room descriptions explicitly mention 'complimentary WIFI' and the site lists on-site dining (Hydra Estiatorio Mediterranean & Bar, Bar Hydra, Hydra Café). However, the website contains no mention of bike storage, cycling procedures, e-bike charging, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenity, so both required WWC criteria remain null.
concerns: No mention of bike storage or cycling-specific services anywhere on the website; both required WWC criteria are unverifiable.
High-end luxury property — cycling amenities may not be offered; confirmation recommended before inclusion.
